mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved for four consecutive weeks from -45.6 to -36.7, indicating reopening momentum and habit formation; this positive autocorrelation continues over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly means rose from -45.6 at t-3w to -36.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days while the four-week trend remains positive without a new restriction shock.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -35 signals restored commuting capacity; more transit trips generate retail footfall, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -35 percent
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -43.4 at t-3w to -33.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the last 28 days while TRANSIT remains above -35.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM improvement from -21.7 to -11.3 indicates normalized essential errands; co-location and trip chaining lift adjacent retail and recreation over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM weekly means rose from -21.7 to -11.3
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM continues above -15 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS swung to +0.7 from -14.9; outdoor recreation substitutes for indoor retail and recreation, diverting discretionary time and spending away from RETAIL_REC over one week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -14.9 at t-3w to +0.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above 0 and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery of WORKPLACES above -46 and TRANSIT above -35 restores weekday commuting and after-work retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks only when both conditions hold.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved to -44.3 and TRANSIT to -33.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If both WORKPLACES > -46 and TRANSIT > -35 hold for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL declined from 11.0 to 8.7, meaning fewer hours at home; released time supports retail and recreation visits over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 11.0 at t-3w to 8.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below 9.0 and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Outdoor recreation (PARKS >= 0) combined with transit recovery (TRANSIT > -35) indicates broad reopening; both jointly lift retail and recreation more than either alone over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at 0.7 and TRANSIT at -33.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS >= 0 and TRANSIT > -35 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where WORKPLACES improves above -46 and RESIDENTIAL falls below 9.0, retail recovery accelerates over four weeks; if WORKPLACES deteriorates while RESIDENTIAL rises, retail stalls.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES at -44.3 and RESIDENTIAL at 8.7 at t-0w
regime_hint: reopening regime; not a lockdown regime
failure_condition: If the reopening regime holds but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days.
